tools.name: ping
tools.title: Ping
tools.description: Basic sanity check tool for verifying the MCP server is reachable.

tools.name: get_trade_request_status
tools.title: Get Order Request Status
tools.description: Check the authenticated user's phone approval and order request using the preview-issued ID as attemptId, including before submission. Read-only: never starts, resumes or retries an order. For an unknown outcome, check open orders and transaction history in Scalable; an order may appear later.

attemptId.description: The attemptId returned by an order request. Checking status never submits or retries an order.

orderId.description: Order identifier for follow-up lookup or cancellation.

tools.name: add_watchlist_item
tools.title: Add Watchlist Item
tools.description: Add one security ISIN to the authenticated portfolio watchlist and return the resulting watchlist state for that security.

isin.description: Valid ISIN to add to the selected portfolio watchlist.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: create_price_alert
tools.title: Create Price Alert
tools.description: Create one security or crypto price alert in the authenticated portfolio and return the created alert plus instrument-level alert capacity.

instrument.description: Exactly one target instrument for the alert.

price.description: Alert trigger price as a positive decimal.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: remove_price_alert
tools.title: Remove Price Alert
tools.description: Remove one price alert by alert id from the authenticated portfolio after resolving its security or crypto instrument context.

alertId.description: Price-alert id to remove from the selected portfolio.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: get_savings_plan_config
tools.title: Get Savings Plan Config
tools.description: Return the allowed savings-plan values and deterministic defaults for one security ISIN in the authenticated portfolio context. Use these options when choosing non-default inputs for preview_savings_plan.

isin.description: Valid ISIN whose savings-plan options should be returned.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: remove_watchlist_item
tools.title: Remove Watchlist Item
tools.description: Remove one security ISIN from the authenticated portfolio watchlist and return the resulting watchlist state for that security.

isin.description: Valid ISIN to remove from the selected portfolio watchlist.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.title: Get Account Profile
tools.description: Return the authenticated user's compact Scalable account profile and broker-portfolio resolution hints.

tools.name: get_fixed_term_account
tools.title: Get Fixed-Term Account
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's details for one personal Fixed-Term account, including contractual dates, accrued interest, estimated payout, current auto-renewal setting, and deposit allocation. Junior accounts are not supported. This tool is read-only.

fixedTermAccountId.description: Fixed-Term account id returned by list_fixed_term_accounts.

tools.name: get_overnight_summary
tools.title: Get Overnight Summary
tools.description: Return the authenticated user's overnight savings account summary with explicit account selection only when needed.

savingsAccountId.description: Optional overnight savings account id to select when the authenticated user has multiple active overnight accounts.

tools.name: list_overnight_transactions
tools.title: List Overnight Transactions
tools.description: List transaction history for one authenticated overnight savings account with optional pagination, transaction-type filters, text search, and time bounds.

savingsAccountId.description: Optional overnight savings account id to select when the authenticated user has multiple active overnight accounts.

pageSize.description: Number of transactions to return per page. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous overnight transactions page.

transactionTypes.description: Optional transaction type filters. Values such as 'interest', 'deposit', or 'withdrawal' are normalized to the supported transaction categories.

searchTerm.description: Optional free-text search term for the transaction history.

fromTime.description: Optional inclusive lower timestamp bound in ISO-8601 whole-second precision with timezone.

toTime.description: Optional inclusive upper timestamp bound in ISO-8601 whole-second precision with timezone.

tools.name: list_accessible_portfolios
tools.title: List Accessible Portfolios
tools.description: Return the broker portfolios accessible to the authenticated Scalable user, with their display names. Use this when a later broker tool needs an explicit portfolioId or when multi-portfolio access must be inspected.

displayName.description: Portfolio name, or null when unavailable.

tools.name: list_wealth_portfolios
tools.title: List Wealth Portfolios
tools.description: List the authenticated user's personal Wealth portfolios with names and current state. Junior accounts are not supported. Use a returned portfolioId with get_wealth_overview to see its current valuation and returns.

portfolioType.description: Portfolio classification; does not determine Wealth access.

tools.name: get_wealth_overview
tools.title: Get Wealth Overview
tools.description: Get current valuation and returns for one personal Wealth portfolio. Select a portfolioId from list_wealth_portfolios when multiple portfolios are available. Amounts are unscaled currency amounts, rates are fractions (0.05 means 5%), currency is fixed to EUR even when valuation is unavailable, and timestamps are preserved without timezone inference. Junior accounts are not supported; holdings and history are not included.

portfolioId.description: Optional Wealth portfolio id. Required when multiple personal Wealth portfolios are available.

valuation.description: Exact decimal string, or null when unavailable.

absoluteReturn.description: Exact decimal string, or null when unavailable.

simpleRateOfReturn.description: Exact decimal string, or null when unavailable.

timeWeightedReturn.description: Exact decimal string, or null when unavailable.

asOf.description: Original local date-time or RFC3339 timestamp; no timezone is inferred.

currency.description: Fixed ISO 4217 currency code for Wealth amounts, including unavailable valuations.

units.description: Amounts are unscaled currency amounts. Rates are fractions: 0.05 means 5%.

tools.name: list_fixed_term_accounts
tools.title: List Fixed-Term Accounts
tools.description: List the authenticated user's available personal Fixed-Term accounts with their current state, deposit amount, term, interest rate, and maturity date. Junior accounts are not supported. Use the returned account id with get_fixed_term_account for more details.

tools.name: get_portfolio_cash_breakdown
tools.title: Get Portfolio Cash Breakdown
tools.description: Return a compact cash, buying-power, credit, and derivatives-availability breakdown for one authenticated broker portfolio.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: get_portfolio_holdings
tools.title: Get Portfolio Holdings
tools.description: Returns a structured view of holdings for the authenticated Scalable user, including security FIFO prices, position market values and valuation currencies when available. Crypto holdings include coins with nonzero quantities or backing ETP positions, retaining pending and blocked quantities. Backing ETPs with missing or entirely zero positions are excluded. Optionally accepts a portfolioId that must belong to the authenticated user.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

fifoPrice.description: Reported FIFO price of the security position, or null when unavailable. Not average acquisition price or tax cost basis. Monetary values retain their number or decimal-string representation.

valuation.description: Reported market value of the complete security position, or null when unavailable. Monetary values retain their number or decimal-string representation.

valuationCurrency.description: Currency of the reported position valuation, or null when unavailable.

tools.name: list_portfolio_groups
tools.title: List Portfolio Groups
tools.description: List portfolio groups, their holdings, and ungrouped holdings for one authenticated broker portfolio.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: get_portfolio_group
tools.title: Get Portfolio Group
tools.description: Get one portfolio group and its holdings for an authenticated broker portfolio.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: create_portfolio_group
tools.title: Create Portfolio Group
tools.description: Create an empty portfolio group in one authenticated broker portfolio.

name.description: Name for the new portfolio group.

description.description: Optional description for the new portfolio group.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: upsert_portfolio_group
tools.title: Update Portfolio Group
tools.description: Change the name or description of one portfolio group without changing omitted fields.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: remove_portfolio_group
tools.title: Remove Portfolio Group
tools.description: Remove one portfolio group; its holdings remain in the portfolio as ungrouped holdings.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: add_portfolio_group_holdings
tools.title: Add Portfolio Group Holdings
tools.description: Assign one or more holdings to a portfolio group in one authenticated broker portfolio. Use it to add ungrouped holdings or move holdings from another group.

isins.description: One or more ISINs to change.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: remove_portfolio_group_holdings
tools.title: Remove Portfolio Group Holdings
tools.description: Unassign one or more holdings from a portfolio group in one authenticated broker portfolio. The holdings remain in the portfolio as ungrouped holdings.

isins.description: One or more ISINs to change.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: get_portfolio_overview
tools.title: Get Portfolio Overview
tools.description: Return a compact overview of one authenticated broker portfolio, including valuation, timestamps, and absolute returns by timeframe.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

includeYearToDate.description: Include year-to-date performance points in the overview response.

tools.name: get_security_chart
tools.title: Get Security Chart
tools.description: Return chart points for one ISIN and timeframe using the authenticated market-data query path without broker-portfolio context.

timeframe.description: Chart timeframe alias using the frozen MCP enum.

tools.name: get_security_news
tools.title: Get Security News
tools.description: Return a localized summary and source list for one ISIN in en_US or de_DE without broker-portfolio context.

locale.description: Optional news locale: en_US or de_DE. Defaults to en_US.

tools.name: list_price_alerts
tools.title: List Price Alerts
tools.description: Return merged security and crypto price alerts for one authenticated portfolio with a stable active-only filter and deterministic sorting.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

activeOnly.description: When true, return only active alerts. Defaults to false.

tools.name: list_savings_plans
tools.title: List Savings Plans
tools.description: Return the authenticated portfolio security and crypto savings plans as compact sorted items.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: list_portfolio_transactions
tools.title: List Portfolio Transactions
tools.description: List broker and crypto transactions for one authenticated portfolio with optional pagination and filters for activity review or follow-up detail lookup.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

pageSize.description: Number of transactions to return per page. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous transactions page.

cryptoCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous crypto transactions page.

transactionTypes.description: Optional transaction type filters. Supported values use the public transaction categories, and loose input such as 'buy' or 'cash transfer in' is normalized.

statuses.description: Optional transaction status filters. Supported values use the public transaction statuses, and loose input such as 'filled' or 'partial filled' is normalized.

searchTerm.description: Optional search term for the transactions list.

fromTime.description: Optional inclusive lower timestamp bound in ISO-8601 format.

toTime.description: Optional inclusive upper timestamp bound in ISO-8601 format.

isin.description: Optional ISIN filter for instrument-related transactions.

cryptoTicker.description: Optional crypto ticker filter for crypto transactions.

includeReinvestmentSubtypes.description: Whether reinvestment subtypes should be included separately.

tools.name: list_watchlist_items
tools.title: List Watchlist Items
tools.description: Return the authenticated portfolio watchlist as compact sorted items with list-focused quote summaries.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: list_order_venues
tools.title: List Order Venues
tools.description: List the supported order venues enabled for one broker portfolio. Use this before an order preview when a venue choice is needed; an order preview still validates the selected security, side, and quantity.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: get_security_quote
tools.title: Get Security Quote
tools.description: Return the selected security identity and the latest available quote snapshot within one authenticated broker portfolio.

isin.description: Valid ISIN to look up within the selected broker portfolio.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: search_derivatives
tools.title: Search Derivatives
tools.description: Return the reduced v1 derivative discovery surface for one underlying ISIN with compact pagination and typed price details.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

underlyingIsin.description: Valid ISIN of the underlying security.

strategy.description: Strategy filter constrained by the derivative family.

limit.description: Maximum number of derivatives to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: search_securities
tools.title: Search Securities
tools.description: Search securities within one authenticated broker portfolio and return compact sorted hits with canonical Broker security-details links for valid ISINs and data for follow-up quote, chart, or watchlist flows.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

tools.name: get_transaction_details
tools.title: Get Transaction Details
tools.description: Return the detailed activity view for one authenticated broker transaction, including status history and variant-specific trade or cash details. Trailing orders show the latest available stop with its timestamp and source; it is not a live quote.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio id to select when the authenticated account has multiple broker portfolios.

stopPriceSource.description: Source of the stop price; not a live quote.
